name: TB-500
description: Synthetic 7-amino-acid peptide (Ac-LKKTETQ), copied from part of the protein thymosin beta-4

note.lead: Not the same as thymosin beta-4.
note.text: TB-500 copies 7 of the protein's 43 amino acids. FDA notes that human trials of the full protein do not apply to TB-500.

bullets: **Contains the actin-binding part** of thymosin beta-4; same binding proposed
**FDA:** not known whether actin binding explains any reported effect
**In horses,** broken into fragments; gone from blood after 6 to 10 hours
**In people,** the mechanism is not established
1 case report: 3 people, mixed with other drugs

practical.routes: Only gum injections, in one 3-person mixed case report
practical.pharmacokinetics: No human data; horses: cleared from blood in 6 to 10 hours

references: FDA, Pharmacy Compounding Advisory Committee briefing on TB-500, July 2026
